name: Obelisk
author: E. T. Carter
description: A single tapering needle crowned by a pyramidion rises alone out of a rolling sea of fog under an empty near-black sky. The camera rides a slow helical orbit, fog dropping away to reveal the shaft on the rise and climbing back over its base on the descent while the monument stands utterly still.

params.label: Orbit speed
params.effect: How fast the camera spirals around the shaft.

params.label: Fog level
params.effect: How high the rolling fog sea laps up the shaft - the pyramidion and tip-light always stay clear above it.

params.label: Tip glow
params.effect: Brightness of the star-point and halo on the pyramidion.

params.label: Rim glow
params.effect: Strength of the hairline light running up the shaft's lit edge.
